integrity: Includes full analytic theorem/proof and standalone standard-library numerical normalizations/reconstruction checker; numerical checks are corroboration, not general proof. Publication priority provisional; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to five equally azimuth-spaced Funk great-circle normals at a common latitude and to complex pure degree-two harmonics. No claim about globally optimal arbitrary five-view geometry, weighted or noisy statistical estimation, or higher-degree bands.
title: Optimal five-view Funk quadrupole tomography on a latitude ring
